args.body: Use fixture-schema.json and, if committed, sku-location-cross-check.json in the existing CATALOGUE-FIXED-PRICE-DELIVERY-TRIAL. The cross-check uses `SKU`, `Barcodes` and `Variant image URL` and tests row location after reordering. Use the documented verifier entry point for the actual passing and failing controls. Anchor each fictional buyer-report finding to the verifier check and manually confirmed SKU and source record. Keep preparation time unknown if it was not reliably measured. Read back the report and execution evidence before closing under a valid lease with a lesson and a keep, narrow or withdraw decision. Keep the report private.

description: The catalogue rehearsal stopped at a header mismatch. The committed fixture inventory identifies the actual columns as `SKU`, `Barcodes` and `Variant image URL`, so the next test uses those fields to locate discrepancies and gives Fulfillment a cross-check for the buyer report. Commercial feedback is available as unverified interpretations. It shows no new interpreted feedback, and five sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 in verified available funds and no verified revenue. The offline trial can proceed without spending. Reassess the provisional CAD 60 offer after the verifier and row-location results agree and the report effort is documented. Any public change remains subject to independent review of its exact digest.
